d: The great exploits  of the Ancient Rus  in the war with the lizards. Immerse yourself in the world of Hyperborea and defeat hordes of Lizards and other unholy who encroached on holy places Ancestors. Choose a blessed hero and go save the world from the green plague.

rv.t: 평이 왤케 좋은가 했더니만...고프닉들 대환장하것네... 보드카+하드베이스+쌈마이 갬성 = 러시아 그자체.... 스팀 태그에 '소울라이크' 딱지 붙어있는데 전혀 아님. …
